feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 10 October 2026 4:14pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 10 October 2026 at 4:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds at first.


##Synopsis##

Slow-moving area of low pressure in the Norwegian Sea will track northeast as a transient ridge of high pressure builds over the area tonight.


##Wind##

West-northwest 5 or 6, decreasing 4 or 5 early tonight, then 2 to 4 later in the night, backing south or southeast 4 or 5 tomorrow afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, becoming slight overnight.


##Weather##

Isolated showers, becoming fair tonight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southeast 4 or 5, increasing 5 or 6, occasionally 7 in the east tomorrow evening, then veering south or southwest 4 or 5 Monday morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming mainly moderate overnight, then slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Fair at first, then rain or drizzle spreads from the west tomorrow evening. Risk of mist and fog patches later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain or drizzle. Occasionally poor or very poor in any mist & fog patches later.
